import copy
import unittest

from solution import project_rows


class ProjectRowsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_more_output_columns_than_input_columns(self):
        rows = [[1, 2], [-1, 3]]
        weights = [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]]
        bias = [10, 20, 30]
        self.assertEqual(project_rows(rows, weights, bias), [
            [19, 32, 45],
            [21, 33, 45],
        ])

    def test_fewer_output_columns_than_input_columns(self):
        rows = [[2, 3, 4]]
        weights = [[1], [10], [100]]
        bias = [5]
        self.assertEqual(project_rows(rows, weights, bias), [[437]])

    def test_square_matrix_and_numeric_mixture(self):
        result = project_rows([[1.5, 2]], [[2, 0.5], [3, 4]], [1, -1])
        self.assertEqual(result, [[10.0, 7.75]])

    def test_empty_rows_are_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(project_rows([], [[1, 2], [3, 4]], [0, 0]), [])

    def test_inputs_are_not_mutated(self):
        rows = [[1, 2]]
        weights = [[3], [4]]
        bias = [5]
        snapshots = copy.deepcopy((rows, weights, bias))
        project_rows(rows, weights, bias)
        self.assertEqual((rows, weights, bias), snapshots)

    def test_outer_container_types(self):
        for rows, weights, bias in [
            ((), [[1]], [0]), ([], (), [0]), ([], [[1]], (0,)),
        ]:
            with self.subTest(rows=rows, weights=weights, bias=bias):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    project_rows(rows, weights, bias)

    def test_empty_and_ragged_weights(self):
        for weights in ([], [[]], [[1, 2], [3]]):
            with self.subTest(weights=weights):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    project_rows([], weights, [])

    def test_malformed_nested_containers(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            project_rows([], [[1], "bad"], [0])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            project_rows(["bad"], [[1]], [0])

    def test_dimension_mismatches(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            project_rows([[1]], [[1], [2]], [0])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            project_rows([], [[1, 2]], [0])

    def test_rejects_non_numeric_and_boolean_scalars(self):
        cases = [
            ([[True]], [[1]], [0]),
            ([[1]], [[False]], [0]),
            ([[1]], [[1]], [True]),
            ([["1"]], [[1]], [0]),
            ([[1]], [[None]], [0]),
            ([[1]], [[1]], ["0"]),
        ]
        for rows, weights, bias in cases:
            with self.subTest(rows=rows, weights=weights, bias=bias):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    project_rows(rows, weights, bias)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
